title: Customer upgrade journey: microcopy, incident-aware changelog, and recovery playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Overview:
This ticket delivers a concise, customer-facing upgrade bundle for runtime-1.20 aimed at LTS customers and self-serve customers on hosted plans. The bundle includes:
- an incident-aware changelog (machine-parseable + human summary)
- short microcopy variants for email, in-app banners, and status pages
- an escalation-aware support playbook with rollback snippets and CLI helpers
- telemetry hooks and event names for tracking upgrade progress and regressions

Goals:
1) Reduce time-to-upgrade by removing cognitive friction in copy and steps.
2) Minimize support volume by proactively surfacing known migration steps and compatibility caveats.
3) Ensure operations can triage and rollback safely if a rollout gate trips.

Scope and deliverables:
- Changelog: JSON + markdown consumers. JSON keys include: headline, summary, severity, affected-features, migration-actions, remediation-links, rollback-snippets. Provide a one-paragraph human summary for marketing emails and a 3‑bullet technical summary for engineering-facing comms.
- Microcopy pack: 3 email subject variants (urgent, recommended, informational), two banner lengths (short/long), SMS-safe line, and Slack/Teams snippet for Customer Success.
- Incident-aware rules: for any changelog item with severity>=high, include a rollback-snippet and a per-customer impact checklist.
- Support playbook: triage checklist, 5 common issues and known fixes, escalation matrix with on-call rotations, and precise CLI rollback commands (with safety flags).
- Telemetry: event names and suggested sample queries for customer-upgrade.started, customer-upgrade.completed, customer-upgrade.failed, customer-upgrade.rolled_back. Dashboards: link to rollout progress dashboard and error breakdown.

Audience segmentation and channel mapping:
- Self-serve developers: email + in-app banner + changelog JSON in docs site.
- Dedicated/Dedicated-Large customers: account rep email + scheduled migration window + phone support.
- Enterprise/private customers: personalized migration guide, optional on-prem runbook, and coordinated maintenance window with SREs.

Risk and gating:
- Rollout gates required before wide release: 24h canary success (error rate <0.5% and latency regressions <5%), no SLO breaches. If gate fails, automatic fallback to previous model variant via routing policy + customer notification.

Acceptance notes for engineering and docs:
- All changelog entries must include migration-actions or explicit "no action required".
- Emails must have unsubscribe and opt-down links per marketing compliance.
- Support playbook validated by SRE and CS on a dry-run.

Notes on differentiation and uniqueness:
This bundle emphasizes "incident-awareness": every changelog line is graded and paired with a concrete remediation or rollback step. The microcopy is A/B ready with short/long variants so comms channels can use appropriate length without rewording. This is intentionally not a generic upgrade playbook; it ties chnagelog severity to runbook actions and telemetry to measure upgrade health in near real-time.

acceptance_criteria: Changelog JSON schema committed and validated against docs site example.
Three microcopy variants approved by CS and Marketing.
Support playbook dry-run executed with SRE and no major gaps recorded.
Telemetry events instrumented and rollout dashboard reflecting canary traffic within 48h of release.
support_runbook: Short triage: 1) Confirm customer release version and route (hosted/dedicated/private). 2) Check customer-upgrade.started event and last known token latency. 3) If increased error rate >0.5% within the canary window, follow rollback-snippet for the model variant and notify CS with templated message. 4) Escalate to SRE if rollback fails or dataplane errors persist. See full runbook link in artifacts.
owner_notes: When authoring changelog items, use concrete migration commands where applicable. Avoid vague guidance like 'may require changes' — instead state the exact affected endpoints and example requests. Coordinate final send times with Growth (timezone-sensitive) to avoid midnight pushes for EU customers.
communication_plan: Phase 0: Internal notice to SRE, CS, and AMs + staging changelog link (T-7 days). Phase 1: Canaries to 1% of traffic (T-3 days). Phase 2: Targeted email to Dedicated and Enterprise customers (T-2 days). Phase 3: Global email and in-app banner after canary success (T+1 day). Use templated subject lines from microcopy pack. Monitor telemetry for 72 hours post wide release.
metrics_success: Primary: upgrade_completion_rate >= 85% within 14 days. Secondary: support_ticket_rate_increment <= 15% over baseline. Canary metrics: error_rate <0.5%, latency_regression <5%.
qa_checklist: Publish changelog JSON and validate schema against docs example.
Sanity tests for rollback CLI snippets in staging running against sample customer profiles.
Email send test to internal QA list and verify unsubscribe links.
In-app banner render test across web and mobile SDKs.
